ambient: A part is picked up, considered, and put down where it was.
The count is done again and agrees with the first count.
Something is written down at the far end of the surface.
description: The parts you're made of, laid out in a good order on a clean surface, and counted. They're all here. Somebody has done this properly and the count came out right and there's no urgency about putting them back.
name: The Inventory

looks: You recognise the use of each one and can't recall operating any of them.
There's one you have no account for, and it's grouped with the others.
objects.name: the parts

looks: Clean, and long, and lit from directly above.
It runs away from you further than the room could hold.
At the far end, more of these, belonging to other people, in the same order.
objects.name: the surface

weather: Cold, level, and without any direction to it.
